title: thelypteris santae-catharinae
intro: Thelypteris santae-catharinae, commonly known as Santa Catherine's maiden fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include relieving symptoms of anxiety and insomnia due to its calming effects. The plant is believed to possess therapeutic actions, including sedative and anxiolytic effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. However, there is limited scientific research on the specific health benefits and bioactive constituents of this plant, and further studies are needed to confirm its potential uses.
